morphology.pattern_note: 完整借词，不拆成 ka- 与 -fe；末音节的 e 为 é 音 /e/，不是央元音 /ə/。以下词族成员为复合词。

word_family.gloss: 书店咖啡馆；阅读咖啡馆

senses.zh_definition: 供应饮料及简餐的小型餐饮场所；咖啡馆。
senses.en_definition: A small restaurant serving drinks and light meals.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat makan bersaiz kecil yang menyediakan hidangan ringan serta minuman.
senses.nuances: 指营业场所，不指咖啡饮料本身；咖啡是 kopi。一般马来语正文写 kafe，词典中的 kafé 用重音符提示读音。kafe siber 特指提供联网电脑服务的场所。依据：[DBP：kafe](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=Kafe)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengusaha kafe diminta memastikan kebersihan premis sentiasa terpelihara.
dual_scenarios.zh: 当局要求咖啡馆经营者持续保持营业场所清洁。
dual_scenarios.en: Café operators have been asked to keep their premises clean at all times.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jom jumpa kat kafe depan stesen tu petang ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Mari kita berjumpa di kafe di hadapan stesen itu pada petang ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 今天傍晚在车站前面那家咖啡馆见吧。
dual_scenarios.en: Let's meet at that café in front of the station this evening.
spoken_features: jom 是日常邀约用语，对应 mari。
kat 对应表示地点的 di。

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah sampai? Aku nak tunggu kat kafe depan stesen tu.
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kamu sudah sampai? Saya mahu menunggu di kafe di hadapan stesen itu.
messages.zh: 你到了吗？我想在车站前面那家咖啡馆等。
messages.en: Are you here yet? I'm going to wait at that café in front of the station.

messages.speaker: Farid (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Belum lagi. Tunggu situ je, aku sampai kejap lagi.
messages.ms_standard: Saya belum sampai. Tunggu sahaja di situ; saya akan tiba sebentar lagi.
messages.zh: 还没。你就在那儿等，我一会儿就到。
messages.en: Not yet. Stay there—I'll be there in a bit.

etymology.historical_story: Kafe belongs to the international café family associated with French café. DBP discusses it alongside butik and kiosk as an example of borrowing that enriches Malay. Its adapted spelling makes the foreign word familiar, while expressions such as kafe siber show how an established hospitality term can acquire a new technological setting. Sources: [DBP on borrowing](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2026/08/11/23718/), [DBP definition](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=Kafe).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kafe 听起来像“咖啡”，但要把画面扩大成一间店：喝的是 kopi，坐的是 kafe。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: kafe 本身语气中性。邀请同事或不熟悉的人时，可说 Boleh kita berjumpa di kafe?；jom 更适合轻松关系。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合约见、简餐和休闲交谈。招待穆斯林朋友时，应了解对方的饮食要求并确认店家的相关信息；店名含 kafe 并不说明其清真认证或菜单情况。
